evidence.title: Asos warns customer data may be compromised after ‘unauthorised’ app access

occurrences.checkable_against: Hacker forums, Telegram channels and Sophos threat-intelligence records
occurrences.quote_span: Xuanye had not been mentioned before on hacker forums or other Telegram channels.
occurrences.speaker: Sophos
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: London Stock Exchange Asos share-price records and Asos insurance disclosures
occurrences.quote_span: Shares later recovered to about 11% down after Asos said it had cybersecurity insurance with a large global provider, including business continuity insurance.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: Cybersecurity threat-intelligence databases and the Telegram link in the notification
occurrences.quote_span: The link directed Asos customers to a Telegram channel apparently operated by the Xuanye Group. Cyber experts said they had not heard of the group before and the push notification might be an attempt to grab wider attention.
occurrences.speaker: Cyber experts
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: Asos website and app status records and business continuity logs
occurrences.quote_span: Our website and app are operating as normal, with no current disruption to any aspects of our operations.
occurrences.speaker: Asos
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: The customer push notification and Snowflake access/security logs
occurrences.quote_span: The message sent out to customers said: “Dear Asos DPO [data protection officer] and IT, we have fully compromised the Snowflake instance.”
occurrences.speaker: the message sender claiming to be the hackers
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: The Xuanye Group Telegram channel and Asos payment-system and app security records
occurrences.quote_span: The Telegram channel operated by the purported hackers, who have named themselves the Xuanye Group, carried a message assuring Asos customers that “payment information is not affected” and a further post stating “the app is safe to use”.
occurrences.speaker: Xuanye Group
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: Asos incident investigation findings and data-breach notification records
occurrences.quote_span: The online fashion retailer said basic personal information including name and contact details might have been accessed by an unidentified third party but it did not believe that payment card records or passwords had been compromised.
occurrences.speaker: Asos
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: Asos-themed phishing reports, emails and text messages following the incident
occurrences.quote_span: Criminals may exploit the publicity by sending emails and texts claiming to be from Asos, perhaps asking customers to reset a password, confirm payment details, check an order or claim a refund.
occurrences.speaker: Marijus Briedis
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: London Stock Exchange Asos share-price records and Asos notification-distribution logs
occurrences.quote_span: The value of Asos’s shares on the London Stock Exchange dived more than 14% after thousands of customers received a notification titled “Asos hacked” with a link that sent them to the Telegram messaging service.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: National Cyber Security Centre case records and communications with Asos
occurrences.quote_span: The National Cyber Security Centre, part of the government’s GCHQ intelligence agency, is offering its assistance to Asos.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: Asos trading-impact assessment and investor disclosures
occurrences.quote_span: However, the company added: “It is too early to quantify any potential impact on trading.”
occurrences.speaker: Asos
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: Asos incident-response records and communications-platform access logs
occurrences.quote_span: We are investigating unauthorised activity involving third-party platforms that we use to communicate with customers. We took immediate action to restrict access to the notification platforms and are working with our internal and external specialist advisers, as well as all relevant authorities.
occurrences.speaker: Asos
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: Asos incident investigation records and the customer notification sent through its app
occurrences.quote_span: Asos is investigating unauthorised access to its app system after shoppers received a notification claiming hackers had “fully compromised” its data.
occurrences.speaker: Asos
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: Asos customer communications and subsequent incident updates
occurrences.quote_span: Customer trust is incredibly important to us, and if the situation changes an update will be provided as appropriate.
occurrences.speaker: Asos
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: The Xuanye Group Telegram post and Asos incident records
occurrences.quote_span: Indicating that Asos had been set some form of deadline, the post added: “The incident involves customer information, it is safe on our server, and it will not be touched for a designated period.”
occurrences.speaker: Xuanye Group
occurrences.subject: Asos

evidence.title: What can I do to protect myself after 'Asos hacked' message?

occurrences.checkable_against: Asos forensic investigation and affected-data inventory
occurrences.quote_span: "However, we don't believe that any payment-card information or account passwords have been impacted," it added.
occurrences.speaker: Asos
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: Asos app push-notification delivery logs and incident investigation records
occurrences.quote_span: On Tuesday morning, Asos users across the UK were sent pop-up messages from its app that appear to have been sent by hackers trying to extort the company.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: Asos subsequent public updates and customer-protection statements
occurrences.quote_span: It said protecting customers "is our priority", and it will provide a further update "as soon as we have confirmed more information".
occurrences.speaker: Asos
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: Asos customer-security guidance and cyber-security expert statements
occurrences.quote_span: - Don't click the link: The hack notification included a link to a Telegram account - Asos and cyber security experts say not to click on it
occurrences.speaker: Asos and cyber security experts
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: Charlotte Wilson's statement to the BBC
occurrences.quote_span: According to Charlotte Wilson, head of enterprise at global cyber-security firm Check Point, "the biggest immediate risk may be what happens next".
occurrences.speaker: Charlotte Wilson
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: Asos customer notice and data-breach assessment
occurrences.quote_span: On Tuesday evening, Asos told customers it may include "basic personal information including name and contact details".
occurrences.speaker: Asos
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: Kat Cereda's statement to the BBC
occurrences.quote_span: The consumer rights expert says they should contact the organisation themselves afterwards through separate means.
occurrences.speaker: Kat Cereda
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: Mobile-device security logs and technical analysis of the Asos notification
occurrences.quote_span: While those who received the pop-up message will undoubtedly be concerned, it does not mean your phone has been hacked.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: Asos customer email and notification records
occurrences.quote_span: The online retailer has emailed customers apologising for the "unauthorised push notification" containing an external link, adding that they should disregard the message and not click on it.
occurrences.speaker: Asos
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: Kat Cereda's statement to the BBC
occurrences.quote_span: People should hang up the phone if they receive any calls from someone they think might be posing as Asos or another organisation, says Which? spokesperson Kat Cereda.
occurrences.speaker: Kat Cereda
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: NCSC guidance on two-step verification
occurrences.quote_span: The National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) calls this "one of the most effective ways to protect your online accounts from cyber criminals".
occurrences.speaker: National Cyber Security Centre
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: Asos website and app availability records
occurrences.quote_span: Asos said its website and app were operating "as normal, and customers can continue to shop with confidence on ASOS as normal" as of Tuesday night.
occurrences.speaker: Asos
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: Charlotte Wilson's statement to the BBC
occurrences.quote_span: But she says they should be "extremely suspicious" of emails, texts or messages claiming their account has been compromised, offering a refund or asking them to click a link to reset their password.
occurrences.speaker: Charlotte Wilson
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: Charlotte Wilson's statement and subsequent fraud reports
occurrences.quote_span: She says criminals know people will be searching for information online and expects there to be "attempts to exploit that confusion".
occurrences.speaker: Charlotte Wilson
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: The push notification content and Asos incident records
occurrences.quote_span: "Dear ASOS DPO and IT, we have fully compromised the Snowflake instance. Engage with us, or we will leak it," the message read.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: Snowflake investigation findings and platform security records
occurrences.quote_span: Data storage company Snowflake told the BBC its investigations had "found no compromise" of its platform.
occurrences.speaker: Snowflake
occurrences.subject: Asos

occurrences.checkable_against: Asos incident-response records and communications with advisers and authorities
occurrences.quote_span: Later that day, Asos said it took immediate action to restrict the apparent hackers' access, was investigating and working with advisers and relevant authorities on "next steps".
occurrences.speaker: Asos
occurrences.subject: Asos
